synth.notes:
Ring y+-6 (A1/A2) carries on-beam blocks and push-chains blocks hit; cancelled if any block leaves the colour-4 playfield bbox or ring leaves field rows.
A4/A3 beam w+-6 in [1, field right]; hooked next/collected block (x==tip-4) drags on-beam blocks; unhooked extend pushes swept next/collected blocks; blocked chain -> beam alone.
Tags: hooked next with all other on-beam collected -> collected (legend-order todo -> next); collected off beam reverts; legend swatch centre 2x2 = 0 while collected.
Render: erase old bboxes to background (4 in field, rail cols x7-8 = 2/3 period 6 over rows top+2..bot-2, rail cols detected excluding object cells, else 5); draw ring, dashed beam, blocks.
HUD bar: 3s from right = (n-1)//3, n = non-click actions, hidden and continuity-gated; unconfirmed fallback n=3*threes+1 after a discontinuity. Clicks are full no-ops.
